senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; <cite ref="C00052">preced. ws.</cite>), constr. <cite ref="C00050"><he>גְּבַהּ</he></cite>

units: <cite ref="Sotah 5a:18">Sot. 5ᵃ</cite> among men <he>ג׳ רואה את הַגָּ׳ וכ׳</he> a high persou looks up to a higher one, but ignores the lower one.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 22:13">Gen. R. s. 22</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 32:1">Ps. XXXII, 1</cite>) happy is he <he>שהוא ג׳ מפשעו וכ׳</he> who is higher than (who controls) his sin, and whose sin is not higher than himself; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 5b:10">Snh. 5ᵇ</cite> (in Chald. diction) <he>אבוה … גְּבַהּ עינים הוה</he> this man’s (my) father was ambitious.—Fem. <he>גְּבוֹהָה</he>.
Ab. V, 19 רוח ג׳ haughtiness, opp. נמוכה.—Pl. גְּבוֹהִים, f. גְּבוֹהוֹת.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 8:5">Esth. R. to IV, 7</cite> <he>הג׳ הושפלו</he> the high were lowered.—
Y. Shebi. VI, 36ᶜ top עיניו … היו ג׳ my father was ambitious, v. supra.—Esp. הַגָּבוֹהַּ the Most High.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:9:3">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵇ</cite> top; ib.ᶜ top <he>בעבודתה בעבודת</he>(<cite ref="E00000"><he>ה</he></cite>)<he>ג׳</he> with a service peculiar to it (that idol), or with a service prescribed for the worship of the Lord; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nazir 6:1:3">Y. Naz. VI, beg. 54ᶜ</cite> <he>למלאכת הג׳</he> referring to a service prescribed for the worship of the Lord (but applied to an idol).—
Y. Ned. I, 37ᵃ top; Y. Naz. I, beg. 51ᵃ לשון ג׳ הוא it is an expression alluding to Divinity, v. חֶרֶס.—לַגָּ׳ for the Lord, on the altar.
<cite ref="Pesachim 3b:8">Pes. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>אליה לג׳ סלקא</he> the fat-tail is offered on the altar; a. fr.

senses.gloss: an abnormally tall and slim person with shaking gait.
